  • Method Details

    • sections

      public LogReporter.Builder sections(Set<LogReporter.Section> sections)
      Replaces the set of sections to print. An empty set is treated the same as never calling this method at all: the default sections (LogReporter.Section.VERSION, LogReporter.Section.COMPONENTS) are used.
      Parameters:
      sections - sections to print.
      Returns:
      this.

    • section

      section - section to print.
      Returns:
      this.

    • maxAlerts

      public LogReporter.Builder maxAlerts(int maxAlerts)
      Maximum number of most recent alerts to print when LogReporter.Section.ALERTS is included. Oldest-first entries beyond this count are omitted, not truncated mid list. Default is 5.
      Parameters:
      maxAlerts - maximum alerts to print, zero or greater.
      Returns:
      this.

    • alertFormatter

      public LogReporter.Builder alertFormatter(LogFormatter alertFormatter)
      Formatter used to render each alert entry when LogReporter.Section.ALERTS is included. Alerts are just LogEvents (see LogAlerts.dump()), so any LogFormatter works here, e.g. one that omits the timestamp for a deterministic report. Default prints [timestamp] LEVEL loggerName - message.
      Parameters:
      alertFormatter - formatter for a single alert.
      Returns:
      this.

    • loggerLevels

      public LogReporter.Builder loggerLevels(boolean loggerLevels)
      Whether to resolve and print each logger's level, via LogConfig.levelResolver(), next to its name when LogReporter.Section.LOGGERS is included. Default is true.
      Parameters:
      loggerLevels - false to print just the bare logger names.
      Returns:
      this.
